pre_start_validation: response_worker.load_policy(path); pure file validation, no network or database
policy_update: Harness atomically replaces the active policy after each real API response returns its task UUID; never fabricate a task. Entries require action, resource, resource_id and, for key/association resources, one fingerprint; association entries also require volume_id. Policy owner/account/serial are fixed to this attempt. Expiry is at most two hours after run_started_at.
queues: Only launcher-owned dedicated queues from resources.json; live URL, ARN and exact ownership tags must match before receiving
guard: Require SQS account_guid, validated envelope account_id and origin_id to match the real account and serial
Only six encryption response event types plus command_ack/error can reach a production handler; heartbeat, full_dump, registration and background list events are ignored on the private queue
Require recorded trace UUID, expected action-specific event, key fingerprint/volume, matching same-tenant task action/resource/executor/creation time
Require command_ack content.task_id == metadata.trace_id; when present its command_message_id must match the actual outbound task message
Use get_task_for_acknowledgement for the pre-authorization read, avoiding get_task's retention-delete side effect
Block MessageClient sends, raw FIFO publication, MQTT publication and MQTT startup in this response-only process
race_handling: Matching response categories with an unregistered trace receive 15-second visibility deferrals for up to five minutes, allowing Swagger to return and the harness to record the task. No processor runs while unregistered. Registered-task processing failures remain retryable; they are not discarded on grace expiry.
production_path: Screen using production InboundCodec with production decryption provider and large-payload reader, without pre-authorization payload cache. Pass the original SQS envelope into the production EventHub async wrapper on the same event loop. Only its synchronous event-loop bridge is skipped; response fields and processor outcomes are not rewritten.
evidence: Only fixed classifications, validated IDs, counts, policy/envelope hashes and exception class names are recorded. Production logs are disabled within the isolated worker; no decrypted body, bearer token, private key or bundle is exported.
success_claim: handler_returned_no_retry is only ingestion evidence. Task completion, SQL domain changes, actual filer state and the originating Swagger response must be independently reconciled.
validation: 46 pure policy/filter/transport-preservation/syntax checks passed; no application handler, worker, queue, database or AWS action executed by these checks
